title: Compare with a Diff flame graph

blocks.content:
Now compare the slow region to a healthy one. `eu-west-1` is significantly more expensive than the others, so you'll set a healthy region (`ap-south-1`) as the baseline and `eu-west-1` as the comparison.

To explore a Diff flame graph, complete the following steps:
Make sure you're on the grouped **region** view for `checkoutservice`.
Click **Compare** to open the **Diff flame graph** view for the two regions.
To compare the same time window in both, highlight a spike in the **Comparison** graph and click **Sync time ranges**, or click **Auto-select** to line up the time windows automatically.

The **Diff flame graph** appears. Similar to a git diff, it highlights where the relative share of time changes between the two flame graphs: red means a larger share in the comparison (`eu-west-1`) than in the baseline (`ap-south-1`); green means a smaller share.
In the table search bar, type `main` to filter the function list.

You can see that `PlaceOrder` calls `processOrder`, which calls `validateOrderWithRegex`. Hovering over each function shows that `eu-west-1` spends a huge amount of time in `validateOrderWithRegex`, unlike `ap-south-1`, so this confirms that this is the cause of our increased CPU usage.
You've found the function responsible for the regional slowdown. Next is an optional AI look at this Diff flame graph.
